state.title: naoqi_rest

part.text:
The robot is now stopped in front of the red wall at the end of the corridor, about 0.6–0.75 m away by sonar. I called rest, so it is crouched with the motors off.

It had no falls or collisions that stopped it for good. A few times collision protection halted a walk, and I turned or sidestepped to get past.
